newsitem.title: UK: Lord Brabazon of Tara to be BIFA President.
newsitem.headline: Lord Brabazon of Tara to be BIFA President.

text.p: Lord Brabazon of Tara, former British Minister for Aviation and Shipping, will be the next President of the British International Freight Association (BIFA), said the association in a statement.
He takes over the Presidency of the 1,100-member association in May, when David Martin-Clark completes his two year term of office.

Lord Brabazon retired from the UK government at the 1992 General Election and since then has been President of both the UK Warehousing Association and the Natural Gas Vehicles Association. He is also a member of the House of Lords (parliamentary) European Communities Sub-committee dealing with energy, transport and trade issues. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
